goal: Checks a new service for logging, metrics, alerts, ownership and its deploy path before go-live.
use: Checks a new service for logging, metrics, alerts, ownership and its deploy path before go-live. Use when a new service is about to go live.
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-new-service-checklist skill on the records for this review.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
pros: Flags each missing item with its expected location.
cons: Not checked: The runtime behaviour; the alert thresholds' suitability.

steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each file is matched to a go-live requirement. A requirement with no file is missing.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: No alert for the error rate
findings.fix: Add an alert on the error rate

findings.title: Request path logs are not structured
findings.fix: Use structured logging on the request path

findings.title: Deploy path has no rollback step
findings.fix: Add a rollback step to the pipeline

outcome.notChecked: The runtime behaviour; the alert thresholds' suitability.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo>`. Note the file count, line count and top-level folders. If the corpus is very large, agree the scope with the user, then narrow it with `--include '<folder>'` (repeatable) on every command. Files over 20 MB are skipped; `--max-bytes N` changes the limit. Report what `scan` lists as skipped.

protocol.title: Partition
protocol.text: Run `WORK=$(mktemp -d)`, then `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py chunk <repo> "$WORK/chunks"`. Chunks are limited to 800 lines and 100,000 characters each, and are cut between definitions where possible. Each `chunk_NNN.md` holds the data notice and labelled file sections. `manifest.json` lists the chunks.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below. It writes `"$WORK/out/<chunk>.out.md"`. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"`. It lists the chunks that still have no output. Process the first one: read it, write its output, then run `pending` again. Repeat until nothing is pending. Never hold all chunks in context at once.

protocol.title: Reduce
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py merge "$WORK/out" --out "$WORK/merged.json"`. If it lists `failed_outputs`, re-run those chunks. A missing or invalid output is not "no findings". Checks that span files are done on the merged list in this step. If the merged list is still too large to read, repeat steps 2 to 4 on the findings.

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: Re-read each file you cite. Confirm each missing item is missing from all the files in the chunk and the manifest.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the report is delivered.
